args.title: Fix password reset email links to use the proper base URL instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently constructs links using a BASE_URL that falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is undefined. This causes reset links to point to localhost in production or testing environments where PUBLIC_URL is not set.

The proposed change advises confirming the application's environment settings and ensuring PUBLIC_URL is correctly set in deployment environment variables to avoid links with localhost addresses. This prevents password reset links from being unusable for users who receive emails with such incorrect URLs.
